missions.title: Make every sales hour worth more than the last
missions.description: We built Business Prospector because we hate burning weeks on spreadsheets. These are the three principles guiding every feature we ship.

competition.title: Beat the competition to the punch
competition.body: Detect local businesses in hours, not weeks. Stop paying for stale databases or chasing leads everyone already called.

publicData.body: We extract whatever anyone can see on Google Maps or Yellow Pages. You decide what to keep, share, or discard.

features.title: Everything you need to fill the pipeline this week

streaming.title: Streaming search
streaming.body: Businesses appear in the table while the engine keeps extracting. Cancelable and retryable at any time.

sources.title: Two sources, one format
sources.body: Google Maps as primary and Yellow Pages as fallback. Normalized, deduplicated data ready for your CRM.

prospects.title: Mark prospects on the fly
prospects.body: One click on the heart and the business jumps to your personal list or a list shared with your team.

folders.title: Shared folders and lists
folders.body: Organize searches by campaign, client, or sector. Invite your team with an email and work on the same view.

excel.title: Export to a clean Excel
excel.body: An Excel with stable columns, no duplicates, and your contact progress. Perfect to hand over to your CRM.

consistent.title: Consistent data

premium.name: Premium

comparison.title: Everything each plan includes
comparison.subtitle: Compare features at a glance and pick the plan you need today. You can upgrade as your team grows.

card.q: Do I need a card for the Free plan?
card.a: No. You sign in with Google and start using Business Prospector with 5 weekly searches without entering any payment data.

switch.q: Can I switch or cancel my plan anytime?
switch.a: Yes. You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel your subscription anytime from your billing panel. You keep access until the end of the paid period.

what.a: Every time you hit the Search button with a category + location combo, one search is consumed, regardless of how many results it returns.

rollover.a: No. The weekly and monthly counters reset automatically; unused searches do not roll into the next period.

team.q: Do Pro and Premium support teams?
team.a: Yes. From Pro you can invite members to shared folders and lists. Premium adds internal messaging, tasks, and timeline to coordinate the work.

payments.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
payments.a: We are finalizing the payments integration. Once enabled, we will accept international cards and the main local methods of each region.

finalCta.subtitle: Create your account with Google and start on the free plan. When you need more volume or collaboration, upgrade to Pro or Premium in a couple of clicks.
